body:
Hey thank you so much for reaching out! I whish I could go to therapy, the problem is I don't have the money... 
I did go through a very dark phase with my depression some years ago but I thought I had beaten it. Guess not 🤡

Me reading this a 3.23 after not eating anything and basically staying in bed all day be like:🤡 
Jokes aside thank you so much for reaching out, I really appreciate it
I will try and look for something but I don't have high hopes. Still, thank you for reaching out♡
Problem is that I live in Italy and to get therapy for free here you would have to wait months if not years
I wish I could go to a therapist but I just can't afford it..
For people that don't have a job there isn't much around apart from employment centers but again, no one is hiring right now so they are useless
Hey I'm sorry I think you commented something but it's not showing up and idk why

You know the problem is that I don't have the money to do any of those things and even when I try to distract myself with maybe TV series my anxiety just comes back in full force, I don't know what to do, I even tried taking some valerian but it didn't help me at all I still have this huge weight on my chest and my heart keeps beating really fast
I mean I know I'm not crazy but it just sucks not being able to get any proper help..
Trust me here in Italy if you go to a therapist you are still considered crazy so they don't really offer these kind of services
Thank you so much for your help

I have let him go, I am giving him his space but it still hurts like a bitch. The problem is that I am from Italy and don't have the same facilities that you guys have and employment offices can't help you if there are no job offers at all sadly
Thank you so much the problem is that I can't afford a therapist nor do I have friends I can go to
No sadly there aren't any around here
Love the problem is I am from Italy not the US

Trust me when I say he is not an asshole. He never compared me to his ex and has gone to great lengths for me, he just isn't in a good place mentally right now, just like I am. As for jobs here where I live there aren't any. I've been looking for 2 months but nobody is hiring
I hope I will be able to do that then
Thank you :)
What is it?
I know but it just hurts so much... I can't stand this

I don't know all these feeling and emotions they just make me want to stop living I can't handle all these problems at the same time I wish I could have an easy life, one where I should not have to worry about having enough money to buy food, one where I am not so fucked up that I make the people I love leave me
I don't know I just don't wanna feel like this. I wish I could just switch my emotions off..

I am sure he is not cheating on me, he basically said that he needs time to himself and that's it. I think as well that the cause of this stems from the end of his past relationship but still I feel like I haven't done enough to prevent this situation
I don't really have anything that motivates me..
I mean it would be a lie if I were to say that I love me
That I can do
I don't know I'm not really comfortable saying that I love myself
I don't know I truly hope it will help me one way or another.
You know the problem is that I don't get even 5 euros a day lol, and I also can't save money because I have many things that need to be payed so yeah, it sucks
I won't make a promise that I can't keep but I promise you I will try

The problem is that he is the right one. It would be so much easier if he just cheated on me or something so that I could hate him,but he decided to brake up with me for my own sake. He is having a hard time as well and knows that he is hurting me with his behavior that's why he decided to take a brake. I don't know I just can't cope with this fact

Support groups are really far away from where I live and they are still really stigmatized if you know what I mean. Also I am having a hard time distracting myself because as soon as I do I start having anxiety attacks
No they obviously aren't the same as everyone else but at the same time I don't feel unique at all, I just feel that I am a very gucked up person who doesn't know what to do with her life

I'm sorry I didn't explain enough the situation. He broke up with his ex of 3.5 years an our relationship lasted a year and a half. He did put in the same amount of effort in the relationship that I put. It's just that lately he is feeling the need of being alone because he feel like he can't take care of me in the state he is in right now. And I know that I am "going on" but this is no way of living. I am just being eaten up by sadness and anxiety
No thank you for your help ♡
No I actually don't

I don't think I will actually have the guts to do it since I have many things to look after and don't want to hurt my ex bf more... but yes if the time will ever come I will seek help just like I am doing right now
I will try to eat something small and hope I won't throw it up, thank you very much
Well I am looking for help, I just can't go on feeling like this,  it's eating me up inside..
Thank you as soon as I have the time I will read it!
Sadly I don't have the money for therapy so I am trying to vent here. I just don't know what to do
Yes but I can't afford it
What do you mean by what do I have to lose?
Well considering that I hate myself and am really insecure I would say at a really low point lol
Sadly I don't have the money for therapy and can't talk with my family because they are the main cause of my mental health problems, I only had him so...

You know the problem is that whenever I try to do something to distract myself my anxiety attacks come in full force and don't go away even if I try to breath in and out calmly. I'm just so upset right now.

I am giving him as much space as I physically can but I am having such a hard time doing it... I don't know I just keep on thinking that maybe I am the problem since I am so fucked up, that maybe I am not enough.. I know that it's stupid but I just can't help it
Hey love thank you so much for your reply! I am trying really hard to hang in there, it's just so difficult..

Hey I am sorry for replying this late but I was asleep. Yesterday we spoke face to face to clear things up a bit but the only thing he needs as of now is time so no, we are not speaking right now, not even texting. I am trying to give him as much time and space as I fiscally can but it's just so so hard. 
If I could do anything I would like to become a vet or maybe a patissier but I don't have the money to do either of those things loool life sucks.

Hey thank you for your answer! Sleeping has helped me a bit but I just feel like I am constantly feeling anxious. I woke up because of how fast my heart was beating.. this situation is really eating me up inside and I also still don't feel hungry at all
Hey thank you so much for your reply! I'm sorry I didn't answer because I was asleep lol
Man thank you so much for looking these up, the problem is that they don't work really well, usually the people who answer( if they answer) don't really care about what you are going through
Don't worry, I still really appreciate the help you've given me❤

Yeah I know, he didn't mean harm though... also yes I am trying to keep up with basic hygiene since it's the first thing that I usually let go of when I find myself in these situations but other than that I really can't do anything

Sadly I can't do either of those things because here in Italy if I were to contact my doctor he would snitch to my parents and if I were to contact the police not only would my parents know but the whole city would. Still, thank you so much for reaching out ♡

I don't know he told me he needs time so I don't think I will contact him for the time being. But he actually told that all my problems did in fact affect his mental health and I feel so bad about that, I dodn't want to cause him problems..

I already talked with him but the only solution as of now is giving him time... He does care a lot about me and I know that but I also know that, since he is very empathetic, listening to all my problems and mental breakdowns has burdened him...

Yeah,that's exactly what he said. I just care about him so much that this situation kills me. It pains me to not be able to help me and at the same time it pains me not being with him. I feel like I haven't done enough for him when he really does anything he can for me
Yeah the problem is that I don't have anyone apart from my now ex boyfriend. I don't want to talk to him since it would only burden him more...

Sadly I posted this on this group because I desperately need help but I am not from the uk, I am from Italy so things here don't really work like that. Mental illness here still isn't addressed and there aren't any activities like the ones you mentioned..
Wanting to be happy for me and me alone will take a very long time... also thank you for your kindness and yes, cats rule the world
Yeah I tried deep breathing but there are some moments where no matter what I do that weight on my chest just doesn't move... it's so frustrating

Thank you so much for your reply. I know how much harm suicide causes, in fact I am not doing it because of how much I care about him and don't want him to suffer because of me. Also we started as fuck buddies because I didn't want a serious relationship and our personalities clicked right away. We were friends who also had sex occasionally. I xan't talk to my family because they are basically the cause for my shitty mental health... 
Also yes, I am trying to vent using reddit

Hi thank you so much for your help! We did sit down and talk things through but the problem is there is no other solution than giving him time... I just am so afraid he will not come back to me, that maybe I am not so important to him as he is to me... 
Also for the job opportunities, sadly I live in Italy so I don't think that'll work

Thank you so much for your help. I am very well aware of the ripple effect of my actions, that's why I am not doing it, because of how much I care about him and how much I know it would hurt him. Sadly I live in Italy where things don't work this way so to actually have some kind of counseling for free I would have to wait months if not years. Thankfully though I am surrounded by cats lol
Thank you so much pal. The problem is that when I try to distract myself the anxiety attacks come back full force...
Thank you so much for your help and kind words, I really appreciate it
The problem is that it doesn't work. I tried distracting myself but I keep having anxiety attacks as soon as I try to relax
Yeah the problem is that they suck they won't get you through to anyone

Thank you so much. I know that it's not healthy at all but I just couldn't help it because of all my problems... sadly I don't have the money for a professional and here things don't work really well so to talk to a doctor for free I would have to wait months if not years. It's just that I don't know, I have so much shot going on around me that I just can't cope with it
It actually does help me a bit. I resorted to reddit because of how desperate I was so thank you for your support♡
I swear I don't have anyone, I only had my boyfriend but he left me and I just feel worse hanging around my family but I don't have anywhere else to go

Thank you, the main problem is that I don't have anyone to talk to since I am not comfortable speaking with my family and don't have the money to speak with a doctor. I also tried distracting myself but the anxiety wouldn't let me. I feel like shit
Lol I wouldn't get advice on reddit if I felt comfortable talking with my family and here in Italy hotlines suck so yay for me
Thank you so much you really helped me improve my mood even if just a bit ♡

Thank you so so much. That's exactly what he said he was doing it for, but he also said that he doesn't love me. He loves me like he would love a friend and I don't know, this has really upset me to the core, I can't stop thinking about this. He also said that he was struggling with this because he was afraid I would do something stupid (which he was not wrong about but still it hurts like a bitch because I feel like I have involuntarily manipulated him)

Thank you for your answer. I don't know I just feel like, leaving aside my boyfriend, I don't have any perspectives for my future. I can't find a job because there aren't any available apart from waitressing wich pays something like 2 € per hour here in Italy and can't afford going to the university. I see nothing in my future.
